input: matrix is a rectangular R by C safe-integer matrix, allowing empty/zero-width input. target is a safe integer. Let H be max absolute cell value or zero. Require 4*R*C*H + abs(target) <= 9007199254740991 and R*(R+1)*C*(C+1)/4 <= 9007199254740991. Padded dimensions/collections fit the shared bounds. All collections are ordinary finite dense arrays/lists, not subclasses, proxies, sparse arrays or accessor-backed collections. Node fields, where present, are ordinary data fields. Every individual collection length and computed allocation dimension/count fits [0,4294967295]; explicitly stated padded sizes and heap child-index arithmetic must also fit the declared exact numeric domain. No concurrent mutation or built-in monkey-patching is permitted. Preconditions are not runtime-checked; allocation/resource capacity and actual completion still require qualification. JavaScript integer inputs are primitive safe-integer Number, excluding negative zero, NaN, infinities, fractions and BigInt; separately declared probabilities are finite primitive Number.
return: Integer number of nonempty contiguous rectangular submatrices summing exactly to target. Empty or zero-width input yields zero.
mutation_aliasing: Inputs and row identities remain unchanged, including aliased read-only rows. Prefix and frequency maps are private; the Solution instance retains no state.
numeric: The four-term prefix query bound covers intermediate cancellation, running column-prefix sums and total-target lookup. Every accumulated answer is at most R*(R+1)*C*(C+1)/4. Each frequency is instead at most C+1, including the initial empty prefix; this separate count is exact under the padded collection bounds. No assumption that only the final sum/count is safe. All integer inputs and integer intermediates (apart from opaque Python identity keys) remain in [-9007199254740991,9007199254740991]; no bitwise coercion is used.
complexity: Expected O(R^2*C + R*C + R^2 + C + 1) time and O((R+1)*(C+1) + C + 1) auxiliary space. Each row pair reduces to a column-prefix frequency scan; hash-table worst cases remain runtime-dependent. Bounds count ordinary built-in allocations and assume bounded-word arithmetic, constant-time indexing, amortized append/pop, and stated hash/sort guarantees where relevant.

helpers.name: matrixPrefix
helpers.contract: Creates padded prefix sums with prefix[r][c] equal to the sum of original cells in [0,r) by [0,c). A running row sum combines disjoint regions with the prior-row prefix. Reads but never changes matrix.
helpers.cost: O(R*C+R+C+1) time and O((R+1)*(C+1)) new storage. Full byte-identical helper is separately charged in every client. The complete definition is 460 UTF-8 bytes; separator newlines are included in total source bytes.

helpers.name: rectangleSum
helpers.contract: Returns the sum of a half-open rectangle [top,bottom) by [left,right) from its padded prefix matrix, with in-bounds ordered endpoints. Empty rectangles return zero.
helpers.cost: O(1) time/storage per query. Four prefix terms and each intermediate subtraction/addition are included and constrained by the declared numeric bound. The complete definition is 156 UTF-8 bytes; separator newlines are included in total source bytes.
